# Latin Link

> Latin Link is a specialist translation company founded by a group of linguists and scientists, trading name of Language Partners Ltd, 12 Hammersmith Grove, London W6 7AP, UK. Trusted specialists in scientific and medical translation: clinical trial, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, medical device, life-science, scientific and technical translation. Every project is translated by a native specialist and reviewed by a second linguist, in a workflow aligned with ISO 17100.

Key facts:
- 15 years translating for the clinical and pharmaceutical industry; based in London with teams across Europe and Latin America.
- Translators work only into their native language and only within their field; at least 5 years' translation experience plus pharmaceutical or clinical work experience; scientific translators hold a master's degree or PhD.
- Languages: Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Brazilian and European Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Polish, Dutch, Swedish, other European combinations, and into English (12 million+ English words a year).
- Latin American regulators covered: ANVISA (Brazil), COFEPRIS (Mexico), INVIMA (Colombia), DIGEMID (Peru), ANMAT (Argentina).
- Contact: Latin Link Projects Team, projects@latinlink.com, +44 20 3286 4122.

## Services
- [Clinical trial translation](https://latinlinkmedical.com/clinical-trial-translation/): protocols, ICFs, IBs, CSRs, CRFs, patient recruitment and Quality of Life instruments.
- [Regulatory and Latin American submission translation](https://latinlinkmedical.com/regulatory-translation-latin-america/): dossiers, SmPCs, PILs, package inserts, PSURs and pharmacovigilance.
- [Medical device translation](https://latinlinkmedical.com/medical-device-translation/): IFUs, DFUs, labelling, packaging and user manuals.
- [Publications and medical communications translation](https://latinlinkmedical.com/medical-communications-translation/): journal manuscripts into English, medical education, brochures and presentations.
